name: Ring of the Wild
body:
Aura faint divination; CL 1st; Slot ring; Price 5,900 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

The bone ring grants the wearer the scent ability and allows the wearer to speak with animals 3/day. Additionally, it also grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on all Survival checks.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring; Spells speak with animals, Survival 2 ranks; Cost 2,950 gp

Identification DC 16
